1541201.name: Laser Shower
1541201.description: Fires a laser beam, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1541202.name: Ultrasonic Wave
1541202.description: Emits an ultrasonic wave, granting buffs that cannot be removed to all summoned Raptures. If its core is destroyed, it will be not able to emit the wave.

1541203.name: Hurtle
1541203.description:
Charges forward quickly, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while Cancel Rings are active. While the barrier is up, only Iron Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1541204.name: Launch Massive Missiles
1541204.description: Launches a volley of missiles from its side containers. The missiles can be intercepted. Any Nikke who is hit will have her DEF reduced. This effect can stack.

1541207.name: Launch Raptures
1541207.description:
Launches Raptures from its side containers. Mother Whale's ATK increases according to the number of remaining Raptures.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while these Raptures are alive. While the barrier is up, only Iron Code Nikkes can deal damage. This code barrier is only generated once per battle.

1541218.name: Mega Howling
1541218.description: Emits a powerful ultrasonic wave. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals massive damage to all Nikkes.

1541219.name: Rapid-Fire Beam Cannon
1541219.description: Fires a barrage of laser beams, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
